QuestInfo.name: Stubborn Rondo
QuestInfo.0: You find Olive in Ereve. As you argue with her about her innocence, someone shows up. \r\nSpeak with Rondo.
QuestInfo.1: Rondo says the Thieves' Guild sent him. He starts to drag her away, despite her claims of innocence, so you reluctantly reveal his secret so he'll free her. \r\nOlive says you can talk to Neinheart in Ereve to prove she's innocent.
QuestInfo.2: Rondo says the Thieves' Guild sent him. He starts to drag her away, despite her claims of innocence, so you reluctantly reveal his secret so he'll free her. \r\nYou find Neinheart in Ereve, as Olive requested.

1.0: Hey, I bet this Neinheart guy can tell us about the disguises. Talk to him for me, yeah? I'm countin' on ya!

yes.0: That guy's actually kinda cute, isn't he? Hehehe.

npc.0: I trusted you with that information! Low blow, pal.
